data.translation:
User 2 已發布 User 1 Haiku 5.5，在人工分析智慧指數上獲得 43 分，比上一版 Haiku 發布一年後提升 26 分

Haiku 5.5 是首款採用 User 2 努力設定與適應性思考的 Haiku 模型，並且 User 2 已推出階層式定價。

Haiku 5.5 比其前身更便宜——對於長度達 100k 令牌的提示，其每 1M 輸入/輸出令牌成本為 $0.10/$0.50（與 GPT-6 Luna 相同，為前版 Haiku 模型的 10%）。然而，超過 100k 後定價將上升 5 倍至 $0.50/$2.50。網站尚未反映階層式定價，因此 Haiku 5.5 的暫定成本數字未包含階梯式費用。我們正在開發支援功能，並將很快跟進任務成本涵蓋。

關鍵要點：

➤ 領先小型模型效能：在最大努力設定下，Haiku 5.5 略微領先於 GLM-5.3 Flash (42)、Gemini 3.8 Flash (41) 及 GPT-6 Luna (38) 等模型。其分數可與 Kimi K3 (44，一款 2.8T 參數開源權重模型) 相比，並落後 User 1 Sonnet 5.5 (最大，56) 13 分

➤ 相較 GPT-6 Luna 使用更多令牌：Haiku 5.5 (最大) 每個智慧指數任務使用約 162k 輸出令牌，約為 GPT-6 Luna (最大，約 50k) 的 3 倍。從 xhigh 轉至 max 設定增加 2 分，但令牌使用量約為 1.8 倍。在相似智慧水準下，其令牌使用量也多於 GPT-6 Luna：Haiku 5.5 (高) 以每個任務約 55k 令牌獲得 38 分，對比 Luna (最大) 以約 50k 令牌獲得 38 分，而在較低努力設定下差距將擴大

➤ 在代理式知識工作中高度能幹：在 AA-Briefcase（我們針對真實知識工作任務的私有評估）中，Haiku 5.5 (最大) 達到 1578 Elo，領先 Kimi K3 及 GLM-5.3 等模型，並可與 Muse Spark 1.3 (最大) 相比

➤ 終端使用改善：在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 上其得分為 33%，高於 Haiku 4.5 的 0%。這與 GLM-5.3 Flash 持平，並領先 Gemini 3.8 Flash (20%) 及 GPT-6 Luna (13%)

➤ 事實知識較低，但幻覺相對較少：如小型模型預期，Haiku 5.5 的事實知識低於其姊妹模型。AA-Omniscience 準確率為 36%，對比 Gemini 3.8 Flash 的 55% 及 GPT-6 Luna 的 44%，但這部分源於其更願意承認不知情——其幻覺率較低，為 40%，對比 55% 及 77%

➤ AutomationBench-AA 結果可能低估：Haiku 5.5 得分 35%，對比 GPT-6 Luna、Gemini 3.8 Flash 及 GLM-5.3 Flash 的 53–60%。在預發布測試中，安全拒絕問題導致模型過度拒絕。User 2 正在解決此問題——我們將使用修復版重新執行此評估，並預期此分數將上升

其他模型細節：

➤ 上下文窗口：100 萬令牌，高於 User 1 4.5 Haiku 的 200k

➤ 定價：每 1M 輸入/輸出令牌 $0.10/$0.50（至 100k 令牌），超過 100k 為 $0.50/$2.50。快取讀取 $0.01（超過 100k 為 $0.05），5 分鐘快取寫入 $0.125（超過 100k 為 $0.625）

➤ 多模態：文字與影像輸入，文字輸出

result.text:
User 2 has released User 1 Haiku 5.5, scoring 43 on the User 11 Intelligence Index - up 26 points one year after the last Haiku release

Haiku 5.5 is the first Haiku model with User 2’s effort settings and adaptive thinking, and User 2 has introduced tiered pricing.

Haiku 5.5 is cheaper than its predecessor - it costs $0.10/$0.50 per 1M input/output tokens for prompts up to 100k tokens (the same as GPT-6 Luna and 10% of the previous Haiku model). However, this pricing rises 5x to $0.50/$2.50 above 100k. The site does not yet reflect tiered pricing, so provisional cost figures for Haiku 5.5 do not include the step up cost. We are working on support and will follow up with Cost per Task coverage soon.

Key takeaways:

➤ Leading small-class model performance: At max effort Haiku 5.5 sits slightly ahead of models such as GLM-5.3 Flash (42), Gemini 3.8 Flash (41) and GPT-6 Luna (38). Its score is comparable to Kimi K3 (44), a 2.8T parameter open weights model, and trails User 1 Sonnet 5.5 (max, 56) by 13 points

➤ Heavy token use compared to GPT-6 Luna: Haiku 5.5 (max) uses ~162k output tokens per Intelligence Index task, ~3x GPT-6 Luna (max, ~50k). Moving from xhigh to max adds 2 points for ~1.8x the tokens. At similar intelligence it also uses more tokens than GPT-6 Luna: Haiku 5.5 (high) scores 38 with ~55k tokens per task against 38 with ~50k for Luna (max), and the gap widens at lower effort settings

➤ Highly capable at agentic knowledge work: on AA-Briefcase, our private evaluation for realistic knowledge work tasks, Haiku 5.5 (max) reaches 1578 Elo, ahead of models including Kimi K3 and GLM-5.3, and comparable to Muse Spark 1.3 (max)

➤ Improvements on terminal use: on Terminal-Bench 4.0 it scores 33%, up from 0% for Haiku 4.5. This is level with GLM-5.3 Flash, and ahead of Gemini 3.8 Flash (20%) and GPT-6 Luna (13%)

➤ Lower factual knowledge, but relatively low hallucinations: as expected for a smaller-class model, Haiku 5.5 has lower factual knowledge than its siblings. AA-Omniscience accuracy is 36%, against 55% for Gemini 3.8 Flash and 44% for GPT-6 Luna, but this is partly driven by more willingness to admit when it doesn’t know - its hallucination rate is lower, at 40% against 55% and 77%

➤ AutomationBench-AA result likely understated: Haiku 5.5 scores 35%, against 53–60% for GPT-6 Luna, Gemini 3.8 Flash and GLM-5.3 Flash. During pre-release testing, a safety refusal issue caused the model to over-refuse. User 2 is working on resolving this - we will re-run this evaluation with the fix, and expect this score to rise

Other model details:

➤ Context window: 1 million tokens, up from 200k for User 1 4.5 Haiku

➤ Pricing: $0.10/$0.50 per 1M input/output tokens up to 100k tokens, $0.50/$2.50 above. Cache reads $0.01 ($0.05 above 100k), 5 minute cache writes $0.125 ($0.625 above 100k)

➤ Multimodality: Text and image input, with text output
